title: A cohomological functor with a small solution set is representable
statement: Let C be a locally small pretriangulated category with Hom sets in universe v, v-indexed coproducts, and split idempotents. Let H:C^op to Ab_v be cohomological and carry these coproducts to products. Suppose there is a v-small family of pairs (A_i,a_i in H(A_i)) such that every z in H(Z) is H(f)(a_i) for some f:Z to A_i. Then the underlying set-valued functor of H is representable.

source.place: Final solution-set-to-representation step of Brown; direct kernel-killing proof inspired by Stacks Project 0A8F, with idempotent splitting.

proof.text: Take the coproduct G of the solution objects and its universal H-element x. Every element of H(Z) is the pullback of x along some Z to G. This uses preservation of products and the universal property of the coproduct.

Form the coproduct of all kernel endomorphisms of (G,x). Its cofiber p:G to Y kills them, and exactness lifts x to y in H(Y). Choose s:Y to G pulling x back to y; then psp=p because ps-id is a kernel endomorphism.
Every kernel map f:Z to G satisfies fp=0. Indeed, lift x along the cofiber of f, map that H-element back to (G,x), and obtain q:G to G with H(q)x=x and fq=0. Since (q-id)p=0, fp=fqp=0.

The endomorphism e=ps is idempotent and kills all kernel maps. Split it into i:E to G and r:G to E. The value H(i)x induces natural bijections Hom(Z,E) to H(Z). Surjectivity follows by mapping a lift Z to G onward along r. For injectivity apply kernel annihilation to the difference of two maps followed by i and then cancel the split monomorphism i. The natural bijections give Mathlib Functor.RepresentableBy.

theorem cohomological_isRepresentable_of_solutionSet
    (H : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}) [H.IsHomological]
    (hH : ∀ I : Type v, PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete I) H)
    (hsol : ∃ (I : Type v) (A : I → C) (a : ∀ i, H.obj (op (A i))),
      ∀ (Z : C) (z : H.obj (op Z)), ∃ (i : I) (f : Z ⟶ A i), H.map f.op (a i) = z) :
    (H ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat).IsRepresentable
